info.title: SketchAssist AI API
info.description:
**SketchAssist AI** - multilingual (English / Kannada / Hindi) forensic sketch assistance and case management.

> **Preliminary investigative aid - requires human review.** This system does not identify people. It performs no face recognition, no face matching and no search of photo databases, and its output must never be treated as evidence of identity.

### How to try it
1. `POST /api/auth/register` (the first account becomes the administrator), then use the returned `access_token`
   with the **Authorize** button above.
2. Open a case, parse a description, generate a sketch with `engine=schematic` (rule-based, not AI) and revise it.
3. AI engines need credentials (see `GET /api/engines`); without them they answer **503** with setup steps.

### Conventions
* Errors always look like `{"detail": "...", "code": "machine_code"}` (validation errors add `fields`).
* A case that is not yours looks exactly like a case that does not exist (404).

get.summary: Is the server (and its database) up?

get.description: The single source of truth for attribute names, allowed values and labels. The web UI builds its forms from this, so it can never offer a value the backend would reject. No sign-in needed.

schema.title: Response Vocabulary Api Meta Attributes Get

post.description: Creates an investigator account and signs you in. The **first** account created on a fresh installation becomes the administrator (needed for dataset inspection and evaluation runs).

get.description: Every number is counted from the database at request time. Administrators see all cases; everyone else sees their own.

post.description: Creates a case and generates its unique ID (`SA-<year>-<6 characters>`).

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Matches case ID, title, investigator reference, investigator name or witness name.
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Matches case ID, title, investigator reference, investigator name or witness name.

patch.summary: Edit a case, change its status or reopen it
patch.description: Set `status` to `in_progress` to reopen a closed case. A closed case can only have its status changed.

delete.summary: Delete a case and all its data
delete.description: Removes the case, its descriptions, notes, sketch versions and stored image files. This cannot be undone.

schema.title: Response List Notes Api Cases  Case Id  Notes Get

post.description: Notes are append-only: they cannot be edited or deleted, to keep an audit trail.

post.summary: Read a witness description (nothing is saved)
post.description: Extracts candidate attributes from English, Kannada or Hindi text with a rule-based parser. Every value comes with the words that caused it. Phrases that were not understood are returned in `unrecognized`, never guessed. This is NOT a trained AI model and gives no confidence score.

schema.title: Response List Descriptions Api Cases  Case Id  Descriptions Get

post.summary: Save a witness description with its reviewed attributes
post.description: The server parses the text itself (it never trusts client-supplied extraction) and stores the original text unchanged. `confirmed_attributes` are the values after the investigator's review; if omitted, the parser's output is used.

put.summary: Update the reviewed attributes of a saved description
put.description: Only the reviewed attributes and the free-text details can change. The original witness text is never edited.

post.summary: Generate a sketch (creates a new version)
post.description: `engine=schematic` draws a rule-based diagram (NOT AI) and always works. `engine=ai` uses the configured AI engine and returns **503 with setup steps** if none is configured - there is never a silent fallback to the schematic engine. Attributes come from `attributes`, else from the reviewed attributes of `description_id`.

422.description: Nothing to draw / no supported change in the instruction

503.description: The chosen engine is not set up (the body lists the setup steps)

502.description: The engine failed or returned an unusable image

post.summary: Revise a sketch with an instruction (creates a new version)
post.description: Reads the instruction (English comparatives such as 'thicker eyebrows', explicit values and removals in English, Hindi or Kannada), turns it into attribute changes and draws a **new** version. The version you revise is never modified. Parts of the instruction that could not be applied are listed in `revision_details.ignored`.

422.description: Nothing to draw / no supported change in the instruction

503.description: The chosen engine is not set up (the body lists the setup steps)

502.description: The engine failed or returned an unusable image

get.summary: All versions of a case, oldest first

get.description: Requires the Authorization header. With `download=true` the PNG gets a caption band stating how the image was made (AI or not), the case, version and time, and is sent as an attachment. The stored file itself is never altered.

post.summary: Select a version as the working copy and report sketch
post.description: Exactly one version per case is selected. It is the one shown in the PDF report. Selecting never changes any image.

get.description: Shows which engines can run right now and why not. `verified` is true only after a real request succeeded since the server started. `last_evaluated_at` comes from stored evaluations and is null when an engine was never evaluated.

get.summary: Which datasets are installed, and what is in them
get.description: Counts come only from real inspections stored in the database. A dataset that is not installed shows zero records. Nothing is downloaded automatically: the three published face-sketch collections have access restrictions and must be obtained by you under their own terms.

post.description: Walks the dataset folder, checks that images can be opened and (for the custom dataset) validates every CSV row. Replaces the stored inventory of the inspected dataset with the fresh result.

get.description: Only real runs are stored. The list is empty until an administrator runs an evaluation.

schema.title: Response List Evaluations Api Evaluations Get

post.description: Parses every valid example of the custom dataset in the chosen split and compares the result with its labels. The number of examples (n) is stored with the metrics. The result carries the limitations of this particular test set.

get.description: Includes case details, the witness text exactly as entered, the reviewed attributes, the selected sketch with its provenance caption, the full version history with instructions, investigator notes, the generation time, and the disclaimers: 'preliminary investigative aid requiring human review' and 'no identification'.

investigator_ref.title: Investigator Ref
investigator_ref.description: Your reference or badge number (letters, digits, space, - _ . /).

investigator_name.title: Investigator Name
investigator_name.description: Name of the investigator in charge of this case.

witness_name.title: Witness Name
witness_name.description: Name of the witness who gave the description. Use a neutral code such as W-01 if the name must be withheld.

access.title: Access
access.description: How to obtain the data legitimately. Nothing is downloaded automatically.

installed.title: Installed
installed.description: Whether files are present in the expected folder right now.

files_found.title: Files Found
files_found.description: From the last inspection; null = never inspected.

records.title: Records
records.description: Rows stored in the database by the last inspection.

translation_review.title: Translation Review
translation_review.description: Custom dataset only: number of rows per translation review status.

label.title: Label
label.description: Who gave this description, for example the witness's name or 'Witness 2'. It is printed in the report.

confirmed_attributes.title: Confirmed Attributes
confirmed_attributes.description: The attributes after the investigator reviewed them. Defaults to the parser's output.

DescriptionUpdate.title: DescriptionUpdate
DescriptionUpdate.description: Only the reviewed attributes can change. The original text is never edited.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: True only after a real request succeeded since the server started.

last_evaluated_at.title: Last Evaluated At
last_evaluated_at.description: From stored evaluations; null = never evaluated.

only_reviewed_translations.title: Only Reviewed Translations
only_reviewed_translations.description: Evaluate only rows whose translation was reviewed by a human.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Words copied from the witness text that caused this value.

description_id.title: Description Id
description_id.description: Use this saved description's reviewed attributes.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes to draw. Overrides the description's reviewed attributes if given.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: 'schematic' = rule-based drawing (not AI). 'ai' = the configured AI engine (needs setup).

dataset_key.title: Dataset Key
dataset_key.description: Inspect one dataset, or all if omitted.

sketch_version_id.title: Sketch Version Id
sketch_version_id.description: Optionally attach the note to a sketch version.

text.title: Text
text.description: The witness description (English, Kannada or Hindi).

lexicon_status.title: Lexicon Status
lexicon_status.description: Review status of each language's word list.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Reminder that the output is an editable estimate.

username.title: Username
username.description: 3-32 characters: letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen.

acknowledge_responsible_use.title: Acknowledge Responsible Use
acknowledge_responsible_use.description: Must be true: confirms you have read the responsible-use statement.

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.description: For example: 'make the eyebrows thicker and add glasses'.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Defaults to the kind of engine that made the sketch being revised.

case_id.title: Case Id
case_id.description: Public case ID this sketch belongs to.

HTTPBearer.description: Log in at POST /api/auth/login, then paste the access_token here.
